name: DAComp
intro: DAComp包含210个任务，模拟复杂企业数据智能工作流，涵盖工业级架构的数据工程和开放式业务问题的数据分析。该基准用于评估自主数据智能体在企业环境中的能力。
org: Institute of Automation, CAS; University of Chinese Academy of Sciences; ByteDance Seed; TikTok; UC San Diego; NUS
build_method: 八位专家基于宽松许可企业资产构建：73 个 SaaS 模式与关系一致的合成数据支撑 DE，100 个 Web 数据库及语义层支撑 DA；经 dbt 基线规范化、资深工程师审计、专家选题/投票、评分标准对齐和多模型覆盖验证形成 210 题
metric: DE 架构用业务/技术/设计三维标准非层次评分且不用 GSB；DE 实现/演化在 DuckDB 精确比对模式和数据，报告 CS、CFS、SR，DE-Evol 以 CFS≥80 判成功；DA 按层次化标准与 GSB 混合评分（0.6/0.4）
modality: 文本, 代码, 表格, SQL
task_type: Agent任务, 代码生成, SQL Generation, 开放式问答
eval_feature: 全生命周期, 仓库级数据工程, 开放式数据分析, 执行与大模型混合评测
task_type_en: Agent Task, Code Generation, SQL Generation, Open-ended QA
build_method_en: Eight experts build from permissively licensed enterprise assets: 73 SaaS schemas plus relationally consistent synthetic data for DE, and 100 web databases with semantic layers for DA; dbt baseline normalization, senior audit, expert selection/voting, rubric alignment, and multi-model coverage validation yield 210 tasks
intro_en: DAComp includes 210 tasks simulating complex enterprise data intelligence workflows, covering industrial-scale data engineering architectures and open-ended business data analysis. This benchmark is used to evaluate the capabilities of autonomous data agents in enterprise environments.

drawio_review_note: Aligned to arXiv:2512.04324v1. Released Hugging Face artifacts are pinned independently: dacomp-de revision 8c4a18983b0733256fffb593f7febb9ab6697854, dacomp-de-gold revision 11f04f026f67ae9dfaabdc0aa9a6f10f70661d08, dacomp-da revision 2cc22149cdfe16cec41851ccae791c2d2c873bb3, and dacomp-da-eval revision 30e915f58df21bd982b29814074c323f19fbe2d9. The paper/project page names an anonymous/DAComp repository, but no paper-pinned public code revision is disclosed, so the diagram does not claim one. Eight experts use Apache-2.0/MIT enterprise assets: 73 SaaS schemas (about 400 columns) and relationally consistent synthetic data for DE, plus 100 web databases and semantic layers for DA. The license-compliant, error-free open-source dbt baseline is normalized to pure SQL by expanding macros/materializations and freezing dependencies, then senior engineers audit joins, grains, SCD logic and tests. Counts are 30 architecture, 30 implementation, 50 evolution and 100 DA tasks; DAComp-zh uses the identical task set. Architecture selects one of five high-level requirements per project; implementation reverse-engineers the vetted baseline into one data_contract.yaml describing the full DAG and semantics; practicing engineers author evolution changes; DA drafts eight questions per table and five annotators vote for the top two. DE architecture uses a standard non-hierarchical business/technical/design rubric without GSB. DE implementation/evolution compare exact DuckDB schema and data with CS (perfect upstream), CFS (predicted upstream/cascade) and SR (all components), with Appendix A.1 defining DE-Evol success at CFS >= 80. DA uses at least three aligned annotators, valid paths and anchor values; five diverse LLMs validate coverage. Its hierarchical rubric covers completeness, accuracy and insightfulness, while GSB compares readability, depth and visualization against five baselines using Gemini-2.5-Flash; the combined score is 0.6 rubric plus 0.4 GSB.
